name: Layout Formation Scroll
description: Photography portfolio page where nine image grids assemble on scroll, each pinned in turn with staggered, rotated and 3D entrances, separated by text sections under a parallax hero frame.
contents: Hero frame with logo text, tags, name, tagline and scroll hint
Nine pinned image grids with different formation animations
Titled intro, about, life, ethics, inspiration, process, collaborations, style, future and contact text sections
behavior: Smooth scrolling through Lenis synced to GSAP ticker
Hero frame shifts down, scales and darkens while scrolling away
Each grid pins at center and its images fly, rotate, skew or flip into place, scrubbed by scroll
Images are preloaded before animations start, then the page scrolls to top

props.name: introText
props.default: Welcome to the portfolio. In a world dominated by speed and constant motion, this photography invites you to slow down and immerse yourself in a visual experience that touches human fragility.

props.name: aboutText
props.default: The lens captures the quiet ache of reality, where shadow and light blur the line between seen and felt. Soft, muted tones breathe life into the ordinary, revealing textures hidden in plain sight.

props.name: lifeText
props.default: Born amid the gentle interplay of light and shadow in the city's quieter corners, the eye was drawn early on to the unnoticed beauty in the mundane, the softness in the grit.

props.name: workEthicsText
props.default: Driven by a strong sense of discipline and dedication, the work reflects a deep commitment to craft and personal growth, with a relentless focus on innovation and detail.

props.name: inspirationText
props.default: Inspiration comes from the quiet, in-between moments of everyday life — the fleeting light at dawn, the subtle movement of shadows, the way stillness can carry untold stories.

props.name: processText
props.default: The creative process begins with stillness and observation, letting the moment speak before any action is taken, immersing in the quiet shifts of light, texture, and mood.

props.name: collaborationsText
props.default: Known for openness to new ideas and innovative approaches, the work thrives on the energy of collaborating with fellow artists, designers, and creative professionals.

props.name: styleText
props.default: The style is rooted in subtlety and restraint, capturing the delicate balance between light and shadow, presence and absence, favoring soft textures and a timeless aesthetic.

props.name: futureText
props.default: Looking ahead, the work envisions diving deeper into the exploration of intimacy and impermanence, blending photography with film and sound for immersive experiences.

props.name: contactText
props.default: Interested in collaborating or just want to say hello? Reach out — always open to new projects and conversations.
